headline: Sammaan Capital Limited certifies timely interest payment on listed debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited submitted Regulation 57 certification to NSE confirming timely payment of interest on its publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures. This is a routine compliance disclosure under SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, 2015.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited, a NBFC/financial services entity, informed the National Stock Exchange of India under Regulation 57 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, that it has made timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued through public issue and listed on stock exchanges. This certification is a mandatory compliance requirement for listed debt issuers and signals credit strength and adherence to bond covenants. The debentures were issued to the public and are actively listed on recognized exchanges.
